newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-UK August stock options busy in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-UK August stock options busy in thin trade.

text.p: Trading in UK stock options fell away by early afternoon on Friday as underlying stocks weakened, traders said.
The bigger trades were in stock options having an August expiry as these options expire on August 20.
Under this category, the main trade in British Telecommunications was the sale of 150 August 385 puts at 5-1/2p which dealers believed was a closing trade.
At 1210 GMT, BT shares had slipped 1-1/2p to 385-1/2p.
And in aero-engine manufacturer, Rolls Royce a short call position was rolled forward.
It involved buying back 123 August 240 calls at 7p in a closing deal and selling 125 August 240 calls at 19p for premium.
Rolls-Royce shares fell 6-1/2p to 243-1/2p and the short calls will make money if the underlying shares wither away to make a maximum profit of 19p if the shares are below 240p at expiry.
Rolls-Royce are due to announce half-year results on August 28.
